[See How Memtime Helps You Capture More Billable Time](https://www.memtime.com/how-it-works)

## **What should I charge per hour?**

Answer the #1 question that determines your success as a freelancer

💰 For billing

![Grow profitability](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/66ede8f3cf534f449306e1e3/69554c2cb3a65cefd047ed36_grow-profitability.png)

##### **Grow profitability**

To make your services profitable, you need to ensure you’re compensated fairly for the amount of work you put in. Calculate your hourly freelance rate based on your actual daily and annual workload, not just the vibes.

📊 For planning

![Improve estimates](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/66ede8f3cf534f449306e1e3/69554cbbd4c6cf3baa6e8242_improve-estimates.png)

##### **Improve estimates**

Clients appreciate consistency. The price you quote in the beginning of a project should match the final invoice – otherwise your reputation suffers. Know your hourly rate ahead of time to make precise estimates and always stay within the scope.

💆 For wellbeing

![Get clarity](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/66ede8f3cf534f449306e1e3/69554d07acd28120e0aa20fb_get-clarity.png)

##### **Get clarity**

If you’re unsure about your hourly rate or the number of hours you actually work, you won’t have the confidence to scale. Our calculator accounts for all your costs and expenses to give you the peace of mind to charge confidently.

## **Freelance pricing calculator**

As a freelancer, you need to consider many variables when determining your hourly rate. Our calculator is built to guide you and take all of them into account.

### **Annual salary target**

Your hourly rate is always tied to your annual revenue target. Your earnings as a self-employed consultant aren’t just the hours you work multiplied by your rate – it’s your total compensation including any time off and any overhead expenses you incurred.

Start by deciding how much you want to earn per year. Our freelance rate calculator will take that number into account to determine your ideal hourly rate.

‍

### **Annual time off**

When you’re self-employed, you’re in charge of your own schedule. Which means you can give yourself as much time off as you want – as long as it’s aligned with your salary target. To calculate your freelance hourly rate, you need to decide how many days a year you’ll be taking off work.

Our calculator excludes weekends by default, so you don’t need to worry about that. Only consider the vacation and holidays you’ll want to observe throughout the year and plug that number in.

### **Daily hours**

We all know how much we’re _supposed_ to work per day. But how much do we actually work? To get a reliable and profitable hourly rate, you need to be honest about the number of hours you work per day. This includes both billable and non-billable time, i.e. what you can put on the invoice as well as the costs you have to absorb as a self-employed person.

### **Billable hours**

Out of the total hours worked, billable hours is what makes it to the invoice. Any revenue-generating work for the clients is considered billable; however, every consultant has their own philosophy around calculating billable time.

For the purposes of this calculator, you need to consider the average daily hours you charge to your clients as their consultant. Not your ideal daily billable target but the actual number of hours you’re able to put on the invoice per day.

### **Business costs**

Anybody who’s run their own business knows that there are costs they can’t directly bill to the clients and have to therefore absorb. We’ve mentioned time off but what about the tools you use as a freelancer and any expenses such as hardware and software, office supplies, rent, utilities, etc.?

To calculate a valid hourly rate, you have to consider these expenses and distribute them evenly among your projects and clients if you want to stay profitable. Make sure to plug your annual business expenses into the calculator as well.

### **Time tracking method**

If there’s one thing that can dramatically impact the profitability of your freelance business without altering your workload, it’s the way that you track time and charge for it. For example, if you estimate your time, you can easily under- or overcharge clients because your memory is unreliable. Most freelancers who guesstimate their hours end up undercharging and overservicing clients.

# 20 Free Business Tools and Calculators for Smarter Invoicing

![1-3.png](https://invopoint.com/storage/1-3.png)

Small businesses do not need more complicated finance software. They need faster answers, clearer invoices, better payment tracking, and practical tools that help them make decisions before money is lost. That is why Invopoint launched a complete collection of [free business tools and calculators](https://invopoint.com/free-business-tools) for SMBs, freelancers, consultants, agencies, and B2B service providers across the USA, UK, and Europe.

The goal is simple: help businesses calculate pricing, tax, VAT, margins, fees, due dates, cash flow, and payment terms before creating an invoice. Once the number is clear, businesses can move directly into professional billing with the [free online invoice generator](https://invopoint.com/free-invoice) and manage the full invoicing workflow inside Invopoint.

## Why Free Business Calculators Matter Before Invoicing

An invoice is not just a document. It is the final output of several financial decisions. Before a business sends an invoice, it usually needs to know what to charge, which tax or VAT rate applies, whether the price is profitable, when payment is due, whether a discount still makes sense, and how much will be received after payment processing fees.

Many small businesses still calculate these numbers manually in spreadsheets, emails, notes, or mental math. That creates risk. A wrong tax amount, weak margin, unclear due date, or underestimated card fee can reduce profit and damage cash flow. Invopoint free tools solve this problem by giving business owners fast, browser-based calculators for everyday financial decisions.

## Start With the Free Invoice Generator

If you already know the amount you need to charge, you can start immediately with the [free online invoice generator](https://invopoint.com/free-invoice). It helps you create a clear, professional invoice for clients without unnecessary complexity. A strong invoice should include customer details, invoice items, payment terms, due date, tax information, total amount due, and a simple structure that makes payment easier for the client.

Invopoint is built for businesses that want faster invoicing, better payment visibility, and cleaner billing operations. The free tools support the decisions around the invoice. The invoice generator helps turn those decisions into a professional billing document.

## Tax, VAT, and Invoice Amount Calculators

Tax and VAT calculations are among the most common invoicing problems for SMBs. The [Sales Tax Calculator](https://invopoint.com/sales-tax-calculator) helps businesses calculate sales tax on a price and understand the tax amount and total amount due. This is useful for US businesses and any company that needs to show sales tax clearly before sending an invoice or quote.

The [VAT Calculator](https://invopoint.com/vat-calculator) helps UK and European businesses add or remove VAT from a price. It shows the net amount, VAT amount, and gross total. This is especially useful for service providers, consultants, agencies, and B2B businesses that need clear VAT breakdowns on invoices.

The [Percentage Calculator](https://invopoint.com/percentage-calculator) gives quick answers for percentage-based calculations used in tax, discounts, commission, pricing checks, and fee splits. It is a simple but useful tool for everyday finance decisions.

## Pricing and Profitability Calculators

Revenue does not automatically mean profit. That is why Invopoint includes calculators focused on pricing, margin, markup, and break-even analysis.

The [Profit Margin Calculator](https://invopoint.com/profit-margin-calculator) helps businesses understand how much profit remains after costs. This is useful before quoting a project, selling a product, or accepting a new client deal. The [Markup Calculator](https://invopoint.com/markup-calculator) helps convert cost into a selling price by adding a markup percentage. This is important because markup and margin are not the same thing.

The [Break-Even Calculator](https://invopoint.com/break-even-calculator) helps estimate how many units, projects, or billable jobs are needed to cover fixed costs. For small businesses, this is useful when testing whether a pricing model is realistic.

The [Discount Calculator](https://invopoint.com/discount-calculator) helps calculate the final price after applying a discount. This is useful for early payment discounts, client negotiations, seasonal offers, and service packages. A discount should never be guessed. It should be checked against margin and cash flow.

## Freelancer, Consultant, and Agency Billing Tools

Freelancers and consultants often underprice their services because they do not separate working hours from billable hours. Invopoint free tools help service businesses calculate rates and invoice totals more accurately.

don't want to connect accounting software.

**Pricing:**

- Starter: $9/month with a 14-day free trial (unlimited invoices, 50 sequence generations/month)
- Pro: $19/month (unlimited everything)

**Pros:**

- No Xero/QuickBooks required
- Choose AI-generated sequences or start from ready-made templates
- 14-day free trial on Starter
- Setup in ~5 minutes
- Lowest entry cost in this category

**Cons:**

- No Xero/QuickBooks sync
- No credit checks or bureau risk scoring
- No late fee enforcement automation
- No client payment portal
- No SMS or phone follow-up

**Verdict:** Best fit for small-volume users who want something that works immediately without integration overhead.

[Start ChaseAI free trial →](https://app.chaseai.app/)

- Credit checks, auto-call, payment portal, forecasting

**Cons:**

- Significantly higher cost at volume
- Requires accounting software integration
- Often overkill for freelancers

**Verdict:** Strong enterprise-leaning AR platform; expensive but justified for larger finance operations. See the full [Chaser pricing comparison](https://chaseai.app/vs/chaser).

## 4\. Satago - Best for UK businesses needing credit data + financing

**Who it's for:** UK businesses that want chasing, Experian credit checks, and invoice finance in one workflow.

**Pricing:** Standard free (limited), Desktop £83/month

## Compare Calwise to Specific Tools

Each comparison page explains the key differences, feature-by-feature breakdowns, and which tool fits which use case.

Calwise vs.

Fellow.ai

Fellow.ai focuses on meeting notes, agendas, and action items. Calwise focuses on automatically calculating what every meeting costs. Different tools for different problems.

[See comparison →](https://calwise.io/alternatives/fellow-ai-alternative)

Calwise vs.

meetingcostcal.com

meetingcostcal.com is a free manual calculator — one meeting at a time, no history. Calwise tracks every meeting automatically using real salary data from HR.

[See comparison →](https://calwise.io/alternatives/meetingcostcal-alternative)

Calwise vs.

MeetingKing

MeetingKing combines meeting management with a manual cost calculator. Calwise specialises in automatic, salary-based cost analytics integrated with your calendar.

[See comparison →](https://calwise.io/alternatives/meetingking-alternative)

Calwise vs.

Beenote

Beenote is a meeting notes and agenda tool with a basic manual cost calculator. Calwise is a dedicated cost analytics platform with real-time tracking and an organisational dashboard.

[See comparison →](https://calwise.io/alternatives/beenote-alternative)

Calwise vs.

Memtime

Memtime automatically tracks all work time for billing and project management. Calwise focuses specifically on meeting cost analytics for HR, Finance, and Operations leaders.

[See comparison →](https://calwise.io/alternatives/memtime-alternative)

Calwise vs.

Hogoflow

Hogoflow is a workflow and productivity tool. Calwise is purpose-built for meeting cost analytics — it shows HR and Finance exactly what every meeting costs the organisation.

[See comparison →](https://calwise.io/alternatives/hogoflow-alternative)

Calwise vs.

Worklenz

Worklenz is an open-source project management platform. Calwise is a meeting cost analytics platform — if your goal is quantifying meeting waste, Calwise is the right tool.

[See comparison →](https://calwise.io/alternatives/worklenz-alternative)

Calwise vs.

InsightDraft

InsightDraft focuses on AI transcription and meeting summaries. Calwise focuses on the financial cost of meetings — different angles on the same problem of meeting overload.

[See comparison →](https://calwise.io/alternatives/insightdraft-alternative)
